description_en: Clears the credential (password or SSH private key) for a specified host account
description_zh: 清除指定主机账户登录凭据（密码或SSH私钥）
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost reset-host-account-credential --instance-id bastionhost-cn-rp640dg0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --credential-type Password --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetHostAccountCredential

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance. The instance contains the host account.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For information about region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host account. The logon credential of this account will be cleared.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of logon credential to clear. Valid values:

Password: The password.

PrivateKey: The SSH private key
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除的登录凭据类型。取值：
Password：密码
PrivateKey：SSH私钥
parameters.name: credential_type

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
